scenario.summary: Registers a new account, searches a simple product, adds it to the wishlist and cart, saves a shipping/billing address, adds and deletes three address-book addresses, checks the wishlist item, moves it to the cart and places orders with Authorize.Net (save card, saved card with CVV), then deletes the saved card.
steps: Search the sheet SKU (homePageData/value0), open it, add to wishlist and cart, checkout, enter address row value0, save
Address Book: verify the saved address; add and delete addresses deleteAddress1..3
Wishlist: verify product image, item name and price; Add to Cart; cart shows the item
Checkout with Custom Flat Rate, Authorize.Net with Save Card, place order
Reorder twice: saved card shown, 'Valid CVV number required.' without CVV, order with CVV
Reorder, delete the saved card and confirm it disappears; log off
stateChanges: New registered account (created-by-test) with addresses, wishlist item and a saved card (deleted at the end)
Two orders placed by the test (created-by-test, not deleted)
assertions: Address Book shows the entered address; deleted addresses disappear
Wishlist item name/price equal the product's; image equals the stored image file
Saved card visible; CVV error 'Valid CVV number required.'; order receipt number visible; card gone after delete
evidence: No account need: the method registers a NEW account (registerForNewCustomer: username = date + time + method prefix + testClassRetailUsers/registerNewUser Username, password = registerNewUser Password) -> both cells created-by-test, as the approved getAnAccount registration entry. REVIEW: each run leaves a new registered account on MaxwellsHardware (no TDA cleanup).

product: homePageData/value0/SearchText z-2410004 (homePage!B35) = 'DeWalt 10 Volt Brushless Compact Reciprocating Saw', Simple, DontTrackInventory, active in Maxwell's Power Tools (tda rows). Searched and opened as the first result, added to wishlist and cart -> PRODUCT_SIMPLE_IN_STOCK {quantityUsed 1}, preferred the sheet SKU (not required).

Not scanned (whole sheet tables via TestData.getHashMap): wishListItems (wishListItem0 = the product name) and wishListItemPrices (its price) -> product.name and product.salesPrice/retailPrice (shown price) in the migrated method.

wishList.verifyProductImages compares the wishlist image with stored files of the sheet product (LogoAndImageConstants.WISHLIST_PRODUCT_IMAGES, .jpg); a fallback product's image cannot match. Decided by the user 2026-11-11: the migration relaxes the check to 'the product image is shown' (not equal to the stored file), so any resolved product works; the product stays preferred, not required.

Address rows value0, deleteAddress1..3 (myAccount sheet) are typed by the test onto its own account (created-by-test); read through the map, not scanned. DeleteAddressSuccessMessage (R3) is masked only because its key contains 'Address': UI text -> expected-output.

Payment: Authorize.Net test card from adminTestData paymentMethods (securityPin B111, masked) -> config (framework test card); no payment key (the Authorize.Net plugin setup is not a vocabulary key). 'Valid CVV number required.' literal -> expected-output.
shipping: Custom Flat Rate (code FLAT) -> SHIPPING_FLAT_RATE_ON_STORE {FLAT, countries us (assumption)} read-only precondition.
Store: openWebstoreUrl opens automation_webStoreUrl (atstage: webstore-z10-atstage, the main store MaxwellsHardware), the same store as the Selenium pdp/quickOrder/plp/home entries.
Profile: work/profiles/profile.json has no observations for these Selenium cells (profiled false); DB facts from bin/tda rows (2026-11-11) where cited.
Scanned constant values (locators, report messages, map keys, delays, regex) are framework constants: role config, no need.
migrate: Selenium reads Excel tables through TestData.getMap / getHashMap; there is no swap for Selenium.
